claims.statement: The employee role is mobile-first: every page ships for 390px and 320px breakpoints with 44px minimum touch targets; the PWA shell lets users install to home screen, work offline, and receive web-push notifications.

The check-in flow reads GPS via navigator.geolocation and posts to /api/v1/attendance/check-in; backend idempotency on (employee, project, date) handles the two-tap-race retry case so the employee never sees a duplicate row.

The advance request sheet renders a fee preview that always matches what the disbursement-time fee calculator produces, because both read the same JSON fee schedule via the same ActiveFeeScheduleAt/ResolveFee helpers.
The service worker (frontend/src/sw.ts) caches the app shell and the last-read timesheet summary so the home screen renders even with no network; submissions surface a queued state in offline mode.
All employee UI copy is Vietnamese inline (no i18n layer) with examples like Chấm công, Tạm ứng, Phiếu lương, Hồ sơ, and tạm ngừng ứng lương for the per-employee kill switch.
